# 1 Enoch Chapter 103 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Epistle of Enoch

---

**103:1** Now-I-swear-unto-you, the-righteous, by-the-majesty-of-His-glory-and-by-His-power-and-greatness, and-by-the-sovereignty-of-His-majesty: I-swear-to-you-that-I-know-a-mystery-and-have-read-the-heavenly-tablets, and-have-seen-the-holy-books, and-have-found-written-therein-and-inscribed-regarding-their-souls.

**103:2** All-goodness-and-joy-and-glory-are-prepared-for-them, and-written-down-for-the-spirits-of-those-who-have-died-in-righteousness, and-that-manifold-good-shall-be-given-to-you-in-recompense-for-your-labours, and-that-your-lot-is-abundantly-beyond-the-lot-of-the-living.

**103:3** And-the-spirits-of-you-who-have-died-in-righteousness-shall-live-and-rejoice, and-their-spirits-shall-not-perish, nor-their-memorial-from-before-the-face-of-the-Great-One-unto-all-the-generations-of-the-world: therefore-no-more-fear-their-contumely.

**103:4** Woe-to-you, ye-sinners, when-ye-have-died, if-ye-die-in-the-wealth-of-your-sins, and-those-who-are-like-you-say-regarding-you: 'Blessed-are-the-sinners: they-have-seen-all-their-days.

**103:5** And-how-they-have-died-in-prosperity-and-in-wealth, and-have-not-seen-tribulation-or-murder-in-their-life; and-they-have-died-in-honour, and-judgment-has-not-been-executed-on-them-during-their-life.'

**103:6** Know-ye, that-their-souls-will-be-made-to-descend-into-Sheol-and-they-shall-be-wretched-in-their-great-tribulation.

**103:7** And-into-darkness-and-chains-and-a-burning-flame-where-there-is-grievous-judgment-shall-their-spirits-enter, and-the-great-judgment-shall-be-for-all-the-generations-of-the-world. Woe-to-you, for-ye-shall-have-no-peace.

**103:8** Say-not-in-regard-to-the-righteous-and-good-who-are-in-life: 'In-our-troubled-days-we-have-toiled-laboriously-and-experienced-every-trouble, and-met-with-much-evil-and-been-consumed, and-have-become-few-and-our-spirit-small.

**103:9** And-we-have-been-destroyed-and-have-not-found-any-to-help-us-even-with-a-word: we-have-been-tortured-and-destroyed, and-not-hoped-to-see-life-from-day-to-day.

**103:10** We-hoped-to-be-the-head-and-have-become-the-tail: we-have-toiled-laboriously-and-had-no-satisfaction-in-our-toil; and-we-have-become-the-food-of-the-sinners-and-the-unrighteous, and-they-have-laid-their-yoke-heavily-upon-us.

**103:11** They-have-had-dominion-over-us-that-hated-us-and-smote-us; and-to-those-that-hated-us-we-have-bowed-our-necks-but-they-pitied-us-not.

**103:12** We-desired-to-get-away-from-them-that-we-might-escape-and-be-at-rest, but-found-no-place-whereunto-we-should-flee-and-be-safe-from-them.

**103:13** And-are-complained-with-weeping-to-the-rulers-in-our-tribulation, and-cried-out-against-those-who-devoured-us, but-they-did-not-attend-to-our-cries-and-would-not-hearken-to-our-voice.

**103:14** And-they-helped-those-who-robbed-us-and-devoured-us-and-those-who-made-us-few; and-they-concealed-their-oppression, and-they-did-not-remove-from-us-the-yoke-of-those-who-devoured-us-and-dispersed-us-and-murdered-us, and-they-concealed-their-murder, and-remembered-not-that-they-had-lifted-up-their-hands-against-us.

**103:15** I-swear-to-you, the-righteous, that-in-heaven-the-angels-remember-you-for-good-before-the-glory-of-the-Great-One: and-your-names-are-written-before-the-glory-of-the-Great-One.

---

*EMET notes: Vv. 8–14 are among the most sociologically raw passages in the Epistle — a first-person lament from the persecuted community, detailing oppression, forced labor, judicial corruption (rulers who sided with oppressors, v. 14), and murder. This is not abstract theology; it is testimony. V. 15 provides the answer to the lament: though human rulers ignored their cries, the angels remember them before God. The heavenly memory is the counterpart to the earthly amnesia.*
